name: fid-coder
description: Windows desktop app for local AI agents
author: Fid Coder

scripts.dev: npm run build:node && concurrently -k -n vite,main,preload,electron -c blue,green,yellow,magenta "vite" "tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 dist/main/index.js dist/preload/index.js && electron ."
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit
